## AutoCertRefresh

Automatically refreshes apps installed from your developer/enterprise certificate. Detects the Apple ID used by Dopamine/host jailbreak, stores a verification token in Keychain, and schedules background refreshes via BGTaskScheduler with launchd fallback.

### Features
- **Auto-detects** your Dopamine/host jailbreak Apple ID
- **Keychain-secured** verification token
- **Background refresh** every 1-24 hours (configurable)
- **Certificate-aware** — only refreshes apps matching your cert
- **Test button** in Settings for manual refresh
- **Rootless compatible** — works with Dopamine, palera1n, roothide

### Requirements
- iOS 14.0+
- Jailbroken (Dopamine, palera1n, roothide, etc.)
- Sileo 2.0+
- PreferenceLoader
- Developer/Enterprise certificate installed

### 1.0.0 (Initial Release)
- Initial release
- Auto-detect Dopamine account
- Keychain token storage
- Background refresh scheduling
- Certificate-based app detection
- Preference bundle with test controls
- Rootless jailbreak compatibility

Configure AutoCertRefresh from **Settings → AutoCertRefresh**:

- **Enable Auto Refresh** — Master toggle
- **Refresh Interval** — 1 to 24 hours
- **Account Override** — Manually specify Apple ID (optional)
- **Use Keychain Token** — Enable secure token verification
- **Setup Verification Token** — Create/verify your token
- **Test Refresh Now** — Manual trigger
- **Clear Stored Token** — Remove token from Keychain

Detected account info displays automatically at the bottom.
